text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan (Perisytiharan

Orang Hidup sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan) 2012.

Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Orang yang dinamakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai Warisan

Kebangsaan dalam bidang yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

JADUAL

(1) (2)

Nama Bidang

Datuk Mohd Nor bin Khalid Kartunis

Ramli bin Ibrahim Tarian Klasik India dan tarian Balet Klasik

Jati Anak Ju Penenun Pua Kumbu

Dibuat 11 Oktober 2012

 DATO' SERI UTAMA DR. RAIS YATIM

 Menteri Penerangan, Komunikasi dan Kebudayaan

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF LIVING PERSON AS A NATIONAL HERITAGE)

ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the National Heritage Act 2005

[Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of Living Person

as a National Heritage) Order 2012.

Declaration of National Heritage

2. The persons named in column (1) of the Schedule are declared as National Heritage in

the field specified in column (2).

SCHEDULE

(1) (2)

Name Field

Datuk Mohd Nor bin Khalid Cartoonist

Ramli bin Ibrahim Indian Classical Dance and Ballet Classical Dance

Jati Anak Ju Pua Kumbu Weaver

Made 11 October 2012

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/3; PN(PU2)652/X]

 DATO' SERI UTAMA DR. RAIS YATIM
